text:
The sympathetic innervation of the gut, which includes the colon affected in this patient's irritable bowel syndrome, comes from preganglionic neurons in the thoracolumbar spinal cord, T7-L2. Their fibers pass through the splanchnic nerves to the prevertebral ganglia (celiac, superior mesenteric and inferior mesenteric). This is the first of the two options, T7-L2. My earlier T10-L2 range was too narrow, and L3-L5 is not sympathetic outflow to the gut.

CONFIDENCE: 82
